caption: The drawing depicts a long, formal dress with a high lace collar and cuffs, rendered in light pastel blue. The dress features full-length sleeves and a floor-length skirt that flares outward, giving it a voluminous appearance. The garment is embellished with intricate vertical panels of floral embroidery running down the front, sleeves, and skirt. The flowers in the embroidery are predominantly pink, purple, blue, and white with green leaves. Decorative lace trims accent the front opening, collar, and cuffs in a gold or beige hue. The background is a plain, light tan color, and there are no other objects or figures visible in the drawing. The label “Étoile Marquise” is printed near the bottom left of the page.
title: Ball Dress
